tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi dkar chag ngo mtshar me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpag yas bsod nams ye shes tshogs zung las// legs byung ngur smrig 'chang gi rnam rol gyis// rgyal ba'i phrin las bzang po rjes skyong ba// yon tan rgya mtsho bla mas dge legs stsol// bu ram shing pa'i rgyu 'khrungs ston mchog gi /sems can smin byed mdzad pa bgrang yas las// tha dad gnas su mdzad chen brgyad bstan tshe// legs byung mchod rten brgyad la phyag bgyis nas// gang las byang chub snying po mngon mdzad dus// dbus rgyur 'chang du dad ldan gyis brtsigs pa// gang la dper blangs byang chen mchod rten 'di// mthong don che ba'i ngo mtshar me long ngom// de la'ang gang zhig dad pa'i dbang pos kun nas bslangs te de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten tshad dang ldan pa brtsigs pa'am/ sngon chad gzhan gyis bzhengs pa dag 'dren byed kyi dbang po'i yul du bgyis pa'am/ dwang ba'i sems kyis phyag mchod kyi phreng ba tshar du dngar bas mchod cing bkur stir byed pa ni skal bar ldan pa'i rgyud la dge ba'i sa bon gsar du 'jog pa nas brtsams te mthar thug byang chub snying po'i bar gyi dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi nyid du nges pa ni/ ji skad du mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdor/ lha dang mi'i 'khor rnam bzhis rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten byas te ring bsrel la mchod na bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob cing*/ sems can de dag srid pa gsum gyi sdug bsngal spangs nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba thob par 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las kyang*/ rin chen mchod rten stong phrag du ma dag /gser dang dngul dang 'on te shel gyi'am// rdo yi snying po'i mchod rten gang gis byas// baiḍūr+ya mchog de bzhin an+da rnyil// la las mu tig ke ke ru las byas// de dag gis kyang byang chub thob par 'gyur// gang gis mchod rten rdo las byas pa dang*// gang gis a ga ru dang tsan+dan nam// gang gis thang shing mchod rten byas pa dang*// la las shing mang gzhan las byas pa dang*// sa dang so phag las ni brtsigs pa yi// rgyal ba'i mchod rten dga' zhing byas pa dang*// de phyir sa rdul phung po dag las kyang*// mya ngam dgon pa dag tu byas pa dang*// byis pa rtsed mor de dang de dag tu// gang gis rgyal ba de phyir mchod rten dag

/bye ma las ni phung po byas pa yang*// de rnams kyis kyang byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes bya ba la sogs pas rgya cher bsngags pa 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs rdzogs su dmigs te mchod rten bzhengs pa dang*/ de la mchod pa byas pa'i bsod nams ni// bla ma'i yon tan zung ba'i rgyud las/ de bzhin mos gus ldan pa'i slob ma yis// bla ma 'das nas gdung bas mchod byas na// thugs kyi dgongs pa gong du yongs rdzogs shing*// slob mas bla ma'i rnam thar snyogs par 'gyur// bla ma 'das pa'i lo zla tshes grangs dag /nges par bzung nas mchod pa byas gyur na// bskal par bsags pa'i sdig chen rab bcom nas// shin tu mi bzad gshin rje'i grong las thar// stong gsum skye bo mig bral srog nyams la// mig srog byin kyang de yi dper mi bzod// de snyed skye bo dgra bcom la bkod nas// bskal par mchod pa'i dge bas dper mi bzod// bskal pa grangs med bsags pa'i sdig pa yang*// mun la nyi ma ji bzhin ma lus sel// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i yid ches lung gi phreng bas blo gros kyi shing rta'i kha lo dad gsum lam du nye bar drangs par brten/ sde dge'i mgon khang srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi bla ma lhun grub ting 'dzin gyis/ rang nyid la stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa'i snying por gyur pa sdom pa gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i 'byor pa bla na med pa'i skal ba bzang por sbyar ba'i sku drin gzhal du med pa'i mkhan po rin po che/ theg gsum bstan pa'i snang byed/ skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ sku gsum yon tan phung po/ dus gsum gzigs pa'i dbang phyug dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams bzang po bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi zab yangs thugs kyi dgongs pa'i chu gter 'gengs pa dang*/ rang nyid ltos dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyud du'ang dge ba'i sa bon rma med pa 'jog cing rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du skye ba'i smon lam gsol ba'i rten du dmigs nas/

byang chub chen po'i mchod rten chen po 'di nyid bzheng ba'i tshad kyi dbye ba ni/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i cha tshad kyi yi ge mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir paṇ+ḍi ta chen po brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang pa'i yi ge'i dgongs pa ltar bzung*/ de la'ang mchod rten che chung gang yang rung ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po dang srog shing can du nges par dgos pa'ang dper na mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i ring bsrel yungs 'phru tsam mchod rten gyi bum pa skyu ru ra tsam/ srog shing khab tsam btsugs nas gdugs rgya shug gi lo ma tsam 'dogs par byed pa de zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar/ 'dir yang lha shing dri bzang po can las byas pa'i srog shing phyogs dang rtse mjug ma 'khrul pa'i gnas rnams su gzungs sngags 'dri bar 'os pa bcas tshul bzhin btsugs te/ ring bsrel la'ang rnam par dbye ba mang du mchis pa las/ chos sku'i ring bsrel zhes bya ba ni/ gzungs sngags byin rlabs can gzhug pa ste/ de ni lhun grub steng gi chos grwa 'dir bzhugs pa'i gzungs par rgyas pa'i dkar chag tu gsal ltar dang por lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs sogs bka' babs bzhi'i bla ma'i mtshan gzungs nas brtsams te 'gro bzang snying po lugs kyi rnam thos sras zhi drag gi brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs kyi bar yongs rdzogs tshar gcig dang gtsug tor gyi gzungs rnams chos 'khor gyi rtse nas bre yan chad du khyab par bzhugs pa dang*/ de nas bum gdan yan chad du rgyud sde gong ma'i gzungs rgyas pa yongs rdzogs tshar bcu gsum/ bang rim bzhir rgyud sde 'og ma'i gzungs yongs rdzogs tshar bcu gsum/ de dag gi bar skabs kun du gzungs par chung ba'i rgyud sde gong 'og gi gzungs yang tshar mang po dang gzungs chen sde lnga tshar sum cu so gsum tsam khyab par bzhugs shing*/

gzhan yang mdo gzungs kyi skor tshar bcu gsum rnams bzhugs so// seng khri'i stod nas bzung ste chos skyong gi skor tshar sum cu so gnyis/ nor lha'i skor tshar sum cu so gnyis/ bkra shis kyi skor rnams tshar sum cu so lnga re/ 'dod gsol tshar gsum/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' chos 'phel gyis tshad ldan du bsgrubs pa'i gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor lo dang*/ yang rab gnas tsam bgyis pa'i 'khor lo cha gcig bcas te/ de dag la'ang dar ling gang rigs kyi na bza' ser po dang bcas par bzhugs so// gdung ring bsrel gyi rigs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung 'khrul med yungs 'bru tsam gnyis/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i dbu lo/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i na bza'/ dkon mchog dpal ldan pa'i gdung tsha sgrol ma dkar mo/ dpal ldan don grub na bza'/ nam mkha' rin chen gdung rus phye ma/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan gdung tsha kye rdo rje'i sku/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs na bza'/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po'i dbu lo bubs/ bkra shis lhun grub gdung rus phye ma dang na bza'/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub pa'i tshems rdog po dang gdung rus phye ma na bza' bcas/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa'i gdung thal/ shug rwa ba kun dga' dpal 'byor dbu skra/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis bzang po'i gdung rus/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i tshe ril/ dga' ldan pa'i skye bdun ril bu/ gtsang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas bsgrubs pa'i dam rdzas ril bu rnams yid ches khyad par can dang*/ dpal sa skya'i rten 'dam dpe bral mar grags pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis nas 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i phyag tu brgyud nas byung ba la/ slar yang ngor pa'i bla ma rim par byon pas bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ri lu sogs byin rlabs rten 'gangs che ba dang lhan cig mkhas btsun bkra shis dbang phyug gis phyag bstar mdzad pa'i rten 'dam las grub pa'i sku brnyan bzhugs pa la/

rdo rje 'chang sku gnyis/ jo bo rje gsum/ sa chen/ bsod nams rtse/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa rin po che/ theg chen chos rje/ kun dga' bzang po/ thub sku rnams re re/ mi 'khrugs pa gnyis/ kye rdor drug mkha' spyod bzhi/ 'jigs byed bzhi/ sgrol dkar gsum/ rnam rgyal ma gcig gur mgon gnyis/ gdong bzhi pa gcig dzam+bha la gcig sāts+tsha gcig ste/ rten 'dam de la bzhugs tshul tho ni/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi tshems/ sa chen gdung rus/ bsod nams rtse mo'i sku chings/ rje btsun grags pa'i sku ber/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta'i dbu lo/ rje btsun gong ma'i gar gos/ sa lo'i sku ber dang pur ras/ bse 'bag rgya gar nas phebs dus kyi zhal khebs/ bdag chen ngag dbang pa'i dbu thod// 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams dbu skra/ glo bo mkhan chen gyi gdung rus dang pur ras/ rtse gdong khri chen pa'i dbu skra/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi ljags thun/ tshar chen gyi rten gtor/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku khrus gdung thal ril bu/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sku chings dang dbu zhwa mgul sgrog paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dbu skra dang na bza'/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan po lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rin po che shes bya bzang po/ mkhan po tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ dbu mdzad kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhas grub bkra shis dpal ldan/ thub bstan mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ bco brgyad pa lha btsun mkhyen rab ngag dbang lhun grub/ zhwa lu mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub rnams kyi gdung rus 'khrul med/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang chu bo gaṅgā nai rañdza sogs rgya bal bod yul gyi gnas chen rnams kyi sa sna chu sna/ rten byin rlabs can mang po'i zhal phyis dang zhal rdul/

rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang po'i gdung sogs byin rlabs rten du ma gcig tu bsres pa'i khungs ldan 'khrul med kho na bzhugs te/ de dag ni chos 'khor nas bum pa'i stod cha yan du na bza' ser po dri bzang dang lhan cig bzhugs su gsol to// de man chad kyi gseb tshag rnams dang gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i khor yug rnams su rin po che'i rdog po gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ mu tig rdog po gsum/ mu men/ byi ru/ g.yu/ sbur len/ shel/ dung dang*/ nya phyis/ gzhan yang rin po che sna tshogs gdus pa'i phye ma/ dar gos sna tshogs kyi tshal bu/ a ru ra ser mdog tsan+dan dkar dmar/ bum pa'i nang rdzas nyer lnga sogs bzang sman sna tshogs dang*/ spos dkar/ ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ 'bru sna tshogs/ dkar gsum/ rgya ja/ gzhan yang chu bo gaṅgā dang nai rañdza'i chu rgyun gyis sbrus pa'i rgya gar gyi sa sna dang chu sna/ ma pham mtsho'i 'jim pa/ gangs ri'i rde'u/ shing thog gi rigs te de rnams thum por byas pas yongs su bkang ste gzhag go /gzungs rnams la'ang rab gnas mdor bsdus sngon du 'gro ba'i gzungs kyi lag len gong ma'i yi ge dang mthun par 'bul ba'i grogs ldan kho bos zhus shing*/ de dag grub 'phral du'ang rab gnas mdor bsdus dang*/ phyi nas rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas par bgyis te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams rdul phran re re'i gor yang rdzogs par 'khod pa'i rang bzhin du bsgrubs zin pas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa kun gyis phyag dang mchod pas bsod nams gsog pa'i rten bla na med pa nyid du yang dag par blta bar rigs te/ ci'i phyir na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du bzhugs pa la mchod pa'i rnam grangs mang pos mchod cing phyag byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas de'i sku gzugs la sogs pa la mchod pa phul te phyag byas pa gnyis bsod nams mang du thob pa la khyad par med de/

rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das kyang chos kyi sku ni rtag pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan du bcas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo sde sogs las rgya cher gsungs so// des na tshul 'di dag ni spros pa dang bcas pa'o// 'jig pa dang bcas pa'o// kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa blun po rnams kyi 'khyal gtam gyi rjes su mi 'brang bar/ legs par 'dod pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung la yid rton par bya'o// smras pa/ bde gshegs mchod rten bus pa'i rtse 'jo las// byung yang skye dgus mchod pa'i 'os che na// ring bsrel nor bu'i rgyal pos yongs gtams pa'i// rten 'di mthong don snying po cis mi che// 'dir 'bad dge ba'i 'od brgyas tshe rabs phreng*// bsags pa'i sdig ltung mun pa rnam bcil nas// bde legs sbrang rtsi'i snod mchod byas pa gang*// 'dren mchog bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul// gzhan don mchog gi go 'phang mchis kyi bar// yang srid kun du dal 'byor rten bzang ldan// mgon gyi dam pas rjes bzung rgyal ba kun// dgyes pa'i phrin las rtag tu bsgrub par shog /ces de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi dkar chag ngo mtshar me long zhes bya ba 'di ni mkhas btsun bla ma lhun grub ting 'dzin pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dza yan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
